name: 全局待办 / dsh-global-todo
description: Cross-session todo list for DeepSeek Harness: one JSON file you own, written by you and your agent, handed to a conversation in one click, with steps that ship as a numbered plan and a review step so an agent's "done" is a claim a person confirms.
longDescription:
DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话待办清单：一份属于你的 JSON 文件，人和 Agent 读写同一份，一键交给某个对话继续干；待办可带步骤（派发时作为编号计划），Agent 标完成只是声明、需人确认。

- 24 条 HTTP 路由、10 个 agent 工具、257 个测试
- 零运行时依赖，无构建步骤；MIT 许可
- DSH >=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0，Node >=22.19.0
- 安装：`dsh plugin add dsh-global-todo`；介绍页 https://lugabeeee.github.io/dsh-global-todo/
